pairs.subject: eval-harness
pairs.evidence: scripts/hybrid-bench/derived.ts:135 An LLM benchmark (haiku/sonnet/opus arms scored against gold or deterministic truth) divides by every planned cell, but cells that hit an engine error were skipped before scoring, so a crash lowers exact-% and also lowers MAE (makes it look better), with no separate failed-cell count; it also runs one trial by default, has no declared decision metric and uses an unpinned model alias as gold.

techniques.evidence: scripts/hybrid-bench/agg.ts:64 Hallucination, count fidelity (agg.ts) and derived fields (derived.ts) are checked by deterministic assertions against computed truth, not by a judge.
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:132 Seven metrics are reported side by side; nothing declares which one is optimized or the threshold the cascade must clear to 'match' gold.
scripts/hybrid-bench/derived.ts:93 Defaults to one trial; when repeats>1 they are pooled into a mean exact-%, with no all-of-N/any-of-N and no variance reported.
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:103 Each arm is run once and the arms are tabulated as a comparison; no within-condition SD is measured, so nothing checks whether the order is resolved.
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:138 The token-saving headline is computed over all items whether or not the cascade's label agreed with gold; there is no view restricted to items both arms got right.
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:76 The gold reference is a model under a floating alias ('opus') with no pinned version or packet, and it grades a same-family proxy (haiku).
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:40 The item set is the first N rows of an unversioned export file, with no scenario id or content version, so re-runs after a re-ingest are silently a different exam.
scripts/hybrid-bench/derived.ts:159 Results stay in memory and are written only at the end (agg.ts does not even catch per-cell errors), so a killed multi-call sweep loses every finished cell.
scripts/hybrid-bench/derived.ts:119 Engine-error cells are dropped without a counted failure family; the scorecard shows exact-% and MAE only, so 'crashed' and 'answered wrong' cannot be told apart.
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:118 Each arm is scored against a fixed reference; there is no pairwise arena or schedule.
scripts/hybrid-bench/run.ts:125 The rows come from scoring each arm against gold, not from pairwise games, so there is no win rate.
